Planetoid_reference.source: Pinned PyG datasets/planetoid.py public url points to kimiyoung/planetoid data

PyG_reference.reason: HeaRT requirements.txt pins torch_geometric2.2.0; heart_env.yml separately has2.1.0.post1, so this is a pinned source algorithm reference, not an assertion about actual server runtime

comparison_selection_policy: Both comparisons are fixed before any payload inspection; no search over transforms or row permutations
literal_exporter_origin: Unknown even if exact equality succeeds

minimal_input_dependency.ind.pubmed.allx: Public sparse node feature rows used in concatenation
minimal_input_dependency.ind.pubmed.test.index: Node-order permutation only; not link heldout edges, pools or outcomes
minimal_input_dependency.ind.pubmed.tx: Remaining public node feature rows used in concatenation

native_Pubmed_loader_transform: Pinned HeaRT main_ncn_CoraCiteseerPubmed.py loaddataset constructs Planetoid(root=dataset,name=name) with no transform; PyG default is transform=None
native_float_conversion: read_file converts todense() through torch.Tensor(out), whose fresh default is float32; comparator requires this default
node_order_parser: Pinned read_txt_array/parse_txt_array reads newline-terminated integers in original order, then torch.long squeeze; comparator preserves that parser and adds schema checks
prospective_comparisons: raw_Planetoid_float32 exact value and bit equality

source_reason: Pubmed does not enter CiteSeer padding or NELL branches. The ordinary feature branch is x=cat([allx,tx],dim=0); x[test_index]=x[sorted_test_index]. x, y, ty, ally, graph are not dependencies of this branch.
